title: Rhipsalis Baccifera - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Mistletoe Cactus
description:
Easy-care Mistletoe Cactus for stunning trailing displays!


KEY FEATURES
• Unique trailing succulent stems, perfect for hanging baskets.
• Easy to care for and adaptable to average home humidity.
• Produces small white flowers and translucent, mistletoe-like berries.
• Non-toxic and pet-friendly.
• Epiphytic habit, adding a touch of jungle charm to your home.


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Cacti & Succulents — Rhipsalis baccifera
Colour: White/Greenish-white flowers, White/Pink berries, Green/Blue-green stems
Season: Flowers winter to spring, sometimes year-round; berries follow
Growth Habit: Trailing


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Bright indirect light
Soil: Well-drained epiphytic cactus compost (e.g., coco coir, perlite, orchid bark)
Watering: Water moderately when in growth, allowing top two inches to dry. Keep just moist in winter.
Spacing: Allow adequate space for trailing stems (ultimate spread 0.5-1 metres)
Height: 2.5-4 metres (trailing length)
Spread: 0.5-1 metres
Hardiness: H1a (Under glass all year, >15°C)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Provide bright, indirect light; avoid direct harsh sunlight, especially afternoon sun.
• Water thoroughly when the topsoil is dry, then allow to drain completely. Avoid letting it sit in water.
• Mist daily with soft water or provide high humidity, especially in dry environments.
• Feed monthly during the growing season with a dilute low-nitrogen or cactus fertiliser.
• Maintain winter temperatures above 10°C. No pruning is generally required, but stems can be trimmed if desired.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
